messages:
sam: quick flag from onboarding: the quickstart sample returns a huge stack trace and HTTP 500 for auth failures and quota hits. new engineers are filing tickets.

maria: can you paste an example response (sanitized)?

sam: sure:
```
HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
Content-Type: application/json
{"error": "java.lang.NullPointerException at com.internal...", "trace": "...full stack..."}
```

sam: they see that and don't know whether to retry, rotate keys, or contact support.

jess: Oof. Two quick wins: (A) sample apps should normalize into typed errors with an `error.code` enum (ERR_AUTH, ERR_RATE_LIMIT, ERR_TRANSIENT, ERR_BAD_REQUEST). (B) strip stack traces from public JSON and add a `support_id` header that maps to internal logs.

alejandro: agreed. runtime team: we still have legacy proxies returning inconsistent codes. we need an edge canonicalizer that maps body+status -> stable shape.

kendra: SDK parity note: make sure python/go/js expose the same typed exception classes and a machine-friendly error.code. sample apps should show both human hint and programmatic fields (retry_after, support_id).

maria: i'll open a runtime ticket for canonicalization and tag eng-runtime + eng-infra. sam, can you file a tiny sample-app PR with the normalization helper and README copy?

sam: will do. suggested helper (pseudo):
```js
function normalizeError(resp) {
  if (resp.status === 401) return { code: 'ERR_AUTH', message: 'authentication required' }
  if (resp.status === 429) return { code: 'ERR_RATE_LIMIT', retry_after: resp.headers['retry-after'] }
  if (resp.status >= 500) return { code: 'ERR_TRANSIENT', support_id: resp.headers['x-support-id'] }
  return { code: 'ERR_UNKNOWN' }
}
```

jess: i'll review the PR. also add a short onboarding blurb: "If error.code == ERR_RATE_LIMIT, honor retry_after or exponential backoff. If ERR_AUTH, refresh/rotate credentials."

alejandro: infra will stop including stack traces in responses and add `x-support-id` next deploy.

kendra: recommend we also add telemetry: attach `support_id` to onboarding funnel so we can correlate where users hit this.

deploy-bot: deploy: sample-app branch `fix/error-shape-guidance` built and staged 705

sam: thanks — let's treat SDK typed errors as required for the next minor release so customer-facing libs behave consistently.
